title: Tallow Harbor rewrote its trial
text:
Tallow Harbor rewrote its trial and published the numbers.

The company has replaced a fourteen-day trial with a usage allowance that does not expire, and has published the conversion numbers on both sides of the change.

Jem Arrowood, who runs growth, says the old trial was measuring how organised a team was rather than whether the product helped, and that the allowance measures the thing the company actually cares about.

The change went live on 22 January 2026. Arrowood concedes the new model is harder to forecast and says the company will publish a follow-up in six months whichever way it goes.
